But that didn't really bother me much. It would be nice not to have that plastic smell but it didn't make it or break it. After a few days of keeping the bag out in the open the smell faded significantly. Also, the plastic case is cheap looking as not made so well. reviews.t: The price was great but one of the brushes already broke and it ...
reviews.x: The price was great but one of the brushes already broke and it hasn't even been used. You get what you pay for. Definitely won't buy inexpensive brushes again. The case they came in reeks of chemicals.

reviews.t: Not Really a Beginner Set, But Lovely And Affordable
reviews.x: Super soft and adorable. Came in a pink pleather case in a plastic wrap with a card with the company name. Well worth the price IMO! Even if a few brushes break/shed, most other brushes cost $3-$15 each so you can't really go wrong! They aren't really a set for beginners, more a set for those of us who want to expand our brush collection a little beyond a beauty blender, crease blending brush and the occasional kabuki face brush. Mostly got this for the fan brushes that I've already tried out wi

I have recently purchased this set of makeup brushes for my little sister's birthday. Some of the brushes were hot pink, light pink and white fading into pink. When I first bought this product online I expected it to have all the brushes the same color, as shown in the picture. However, I actually love all the different colors I have recived in the set and so does my little sister! I highly recommend buying Beauty Bon's makeup brushes set!

reviews.t: Make up brushes are cheap quality
reviews.x: I got this set because it was highly recommended and the reviews/ratings it has on Amazon indicated it was a great deal. However, this was not the case with my set! I've had it for less than two weeks and I've only (gently) used them maybe 4 times and the bristles are already falling apart. Well the entire brush seems to be falling apart. I would suggest you buy something else!

Perfect set of brushes! The package didn't include the paper that is meant to let you know what each brush is used for but I wouldn't have ordered tham had I not known most of them anyways. Very happy with this order and it was a third of the price Groupon was charging for the same set.

reviews.t: It is a whole lot of brushes that are great, really pretty
reviews.x: It is a whole lot of brushes that are great, really pretty,  and you can get them for a very reasonable price.  You will not need brushes for a loong time if you buy this set!

The quality of the brushes are pretty good. The brushes are very soft, pick up makeup pretty well, and very little shedding. They do have a few stray bristles that are too long but no big deal you can just cut them as you find them. The only true complaint that I do have is that when you order something you should get exactly what you have ordered. reviews.t: ... the brush hairs were falling out and took a terrible shape from being bundled up together
reviews.x: Some of the brush hairs were falling out and took a terrible shape from being bundled up together. I am hoping that a good soak and wash will straighten out the brushes.  Not recommended as a starter brush kit as it does not come with very many blending brushed. Would recommend for a Special Fx makeup artist.

WOW cheap! I mean I knew I was buying not the most expensive product, but that much ....?! The pink faux leather case had dark stains all over plus dirt, also missing 2 brushes. Not recommending to anyone, spend more money to avoid disappointment.

They are okay if you want to give a gift to a young child or teenager . But, if you use makeup often, don't buy this product. There is only 2 eyebrushes in here that I use, 4 have broken and the face brushes are no good.

reviews.t: These are great brushed, the fibers are very soft
reviews.x: These are great brushed, the fibers are very soft. It seems like the actual fiber part is a little bit loose where it connects to the handle, but I haven't had any come out, and Ive been using them for a few months.

reviews.t: YOU GET WHAT YOU PAY FOR
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:1689b2a05a56cafc65bab020a09f6792]] Very weird smelling pink  plastic carrying case . Handles to the brushes are cheaply made . Brushes ARE soft & pretty pink but very cheap at that . Decent product
Doesn't look anything like the picture...extremely disappointed. Case smells like paint. I got them for my 7 year old so she doesn't care, but who markets a product like this?!?
This brush set is everything you'll need! Great quality and price! The brush bristles are so soft, I'm in love! I recommend it!

claims.text: Many reviewers find the set to be a great value and affordable for the number of brushes included.
Several reviewers report quality problems such as broken brushes, frayed or shedding bristles, and loose fibers.
A recurring complaint is a strong chemical or plastic odor from the brushes and case.
Multiple reviewers describe the brushes as soft and pretty.
Some reviewers received sets with missing brushes, stains, or colors different from the listing.
